title: CB Marketing Brand Brandgogo Raises ¥10M Angel for TikTok Creator Marketplace
summary: On May 18, 2022, CB marketing brand Brandgogo (founded 2018; TikTok digital marketing SaaS matching sellers with mid-tier creators) closed a ¥10M angel for team, overseas creator ops, ecosystem, and owned global account matrix. Clients include Peacebird, Skechers, Aigo, Liby.
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Company / Funding · May 20, 2022

On May 18, 2022, CB marketing brand Brandgogo (founded 2018; TikTok digital marketing SaaS matching sellers with mid-tier creators) closed a ¥10M angel for team, overseas creator ops, ecosystem, and owned global account matrix. Clients include Peacebird, Skechers, Aigo, Liby. Context: TikTok >3B downloads, #1 in 141 countries, MAU >1.2B.

— END —
